quarterly_data.signal: CEO Kash Shaikh said that based on the guidance given at the last earnings call, Penguin expects yet another record quarter at company level and that it will be the company's first quarter over $500 million of net sales. Upside to the FY2027 outlook depends on how fast Penguin can convert the large AI factory opportunities already in its pipeline.
quarterly_data.figure: first over $500 million net sales for the company

quarterly_data.signal: On navigating memory scarcity: a set of Penguin's Integrated Memory OEM customers hold their own supply agreements directly with the memory suppliers - 'whether it is Micron or SK hynix or Samsung' - and that represents about 50% of the business depending on the quarter. For the remaining customers Penguin procures the memory itself on long-term relationships and supplier contracts, which management says gives Penguin more pricing power in a supply-constrained environment because it is both securing the memory and adding design, validation and manufacturing value on the board.

Photonic memory roadmap timing: Penguin's photonics work is based on its early investment in Celestial AI, which was acquired about six months ago by Marvell for $5.5 billion. Penguin continues active R&D with the Celestial AI team on an appliance giving very high-speed photonic connectivity between GPUs and HBM, expanding high-bandwidth memory beyond the directly attached HBM inside the GPU. Management said the availability of that product will be second half calendar year 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: availability second half calendar year 2027; Celestial AI acquired by Marvell for $5.5 billion

quarterly_data.signal: CXL demand is broadening past the first customer: Penguin is now working with data center customers including hyperscalers that are considering its CXL memory expansion cards, specifically in environments where DDR5 is a bottleneck and they are looking for maximum throughput and performance for their GPUs. On MemoryAI, the tier 1 financial institution was 'the first customer who actually bought it' and management said Penguin now has other customers for the product, spanning hyperscalers, neocloud providers and enterprise.
